    Calculates the value of P = (b - c^2)(bc - 1)(c - b^2)

    c = sqrt2 * np.sin(theta)
    
    # P = (b - c^2)(bc - 1)(c - b^2)
    term1 = b - c**2
    term2 = b * c - 1
    term3 = c - b**2
    
    return term1 * term2 * term3

# We want to find the minimum of P(theta) in [0, 2*pi]
